studies.finding: The source TSA comparison increases sliding events approximately two- to fourfold by sixty minutes in four tested cells, while tip-associated events do not increase. A tubacin comparison gives a similar qualitative response, strengthening the connection to HDAC6-linked state. After source hyperacetylation treatment, sliding also occurs on straighter microtubules. Untreated curvature/acetylation association therefore does not identify geometric curvature as a universal prerequisite for sliding.
limitations: TSA has broad targets and tubacin inhibits HDAC6, which can have substrates beyond tubulin. The comparison does not uniquely isolate an acetylation-only molecular mechanism.
The four cells and multiple event windows are nested, finite source observations, not independent publications or a universal effect-size law.
No curvature constants, raw blot quantification, molecular motor force or universal organelle-transport threshold is newly admitted.
